in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhagirth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhagirth is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'bhag' meaning fortune and 'ith' meaning to come. This name suggests one who is blessed with abundance and good fortune.
